records.subject: You're in -- let's get Harbor Works set up
records.body:
Hi Hana,

Your workspace for Harbor Works is ready to go. The single highest-leverage thing in week one is creating a real project rather than a test one -- it's what makes the first week actually useful.

I'm here if anything's unclear.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with zero product progress: no first project, no invite, no key milestone, and no reply to the welcome email [email:edb9cae9]. No tickets or inbound signal of any engagement at all, leaving 8 days. Silent, fully disengaged accounts rarely self-activate, though Pro status implies some intent.

draft.subject: Getting Harbor Works' first project going
draft.body:
Hi Hana,

Following up on my note from last week -- I know launch weeks get busy. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so creating one real project is the step that makes everything else click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time whenever you're ready to bring the team in.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through that first project with you and answer anything as we go.

Best,
Priya
